subject: DI03000151

intro_text.en: Follow a workshop case,understand one idea at a time,and practise turning understanding into exam answers.
intro_text.gu: Workshopના એક કિસ્સાથી શરૂઆત કરીએ;એક-એક ખ્યાલ સમજીએ અને તેને પરીક્ષાના જવાબમાં ગોઠવતાં શીખીએ.

body.en:
Start with a situation

A gear can have the correct outside diameter and still run noisily.A bolt can have the right major diameter and still fail to mate.

Definition

Gear and thread metrology checks functional geometry,not just outside size.

Understand the reason

Pitch,tooth form,thickness,runout and alignment affect gearing.Thread pitch,lead,flank angle and effective diameter affect mating.

Example / application

Identify the nominal geometry and drawing standard before choosing contacts.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A single diameter measurement cannot certify all tooth/thread errors.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Gearનો outside diameter સાચો છતાં અવાજ આવે.Boltનો major diameter સાચો છતાં mating ન થાય.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Gear અને thread metrology functional geometry તપાસે છે,ફક્ત outside size નહિ.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Gearingમાં pitch,tooth form,thickness,runout,alignment મહત્વનાં છે.Thread matingમાં pitch,lead,flank angle,effective diameter મહત્વનાં છે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Contacts પસંદ કરતાં nominal geometry અને drawing standard ઓળખો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

એક diameter measurement બધા tooth/thread errors certify નથી કરતું.

body.en:
Definition

For a standard unshifted external spur gear,modulem=d/z,pitch diameterd=mz,circular pitchp=pi m and base diameterdb=dcos alpha.

Pressure anglealpha defines the line-of-action geometry.Circular pitch is the arc spacing of corresponding adjacent teeth on the pitch circle.

Under the stated standard full-depth ideal geometry,addendum=m,dedendum=1.25m,outside diameter=m(z+2),root diameter=m(z−2.5).

Example / application

For m2mm,z20:d40mm,p6.2832mm;ideal outside44mm,root35mm.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Profile shift,modified addendum and other standards change these relations;do not infer module from outside diameter without checking assumptions.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Standard unshifted external spur gear માટે module m=d/z,pitch diameter d=mz,circular pitch p=pi m અને base diameter db=dcos alpha.

Pressure angle alpha line-of-action geometry નક્કી કરે.Circular pitch pitch circle પર adjacent teethના સમાન pointsનું arc spacing છે.

આપેલી standard full-depth ideal geometryમાં addendum=m,dedendum=1.25m,outside diameter=m(z+2),root diameter=m(z−2.5).

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

m2mm,z20 માટે:d40mm,p6.2832mm;ideal outside44mm,root35mm.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Profile shift,modified addendum કે બીજા standardsમાં સંબંધ બદલાય;શરતો તપાસ્યા વગર outside diameterથી module ન કાઢો.

body.en:
Definition

Pitch checking compares successive tooth positions;radial runout is assessed with a suitable contact referenced to the gear datum axis.

Construction:parts and purpose

A qualified mandrel/centres or measuring spindle establishes the axis.

A pitch-comparator system contacts corresponding tooth flanks.

A suitable ball/pin and indicator can sample tooth-space radial position.

Indexing and records identify each measured tooth/space.

Working:sequence and reason

Inspect the bore/datum and mount without unintended eccentricity.

Check pitch with the specified comparator/indexing procedure.

For runout,seat the specified contact consistently in successive tooth spaces.

Record maximum/minimum and analyse spindle,fixture and tooth-form effects before reporting.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Outside-tip TIR is not automatically tooth-space runout or cumulative pitch error;identify the actual measured feature.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Pitch checking successive tooth positions સરખાવે;radial runoutમાં gear datum axis સામે યોગ્ય contactથી તપાસીએ.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Qualified mandrel/centres કે spindle axis આપે.

Pitch-comparator corresponding tooth flanksને contact કરે.

યોગ્ય ball/pin અને indicator tooth-space radial position લે.

Indexing/records દરેક tooth/space ઓળખાવે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Bore/datum તપાસી અનિચ્છિત eccentricity વગર mount કરો.

Specified comparator/indexingથી pitch તપાસો.

Runoutમાં specified contactને successive tooth spacesમાં સતત યોગ્ય બેસાડો.

Maximum/minimum નોંધો અને report પહેલાં spindle,fixture,tooth-form effects જુઓ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Outside-tip TIR આપમેળે tooth-space runout કે cumulative pitch error નથી;actual feature ઓળખો.

body.en:
Definition

A gear tooth Vernier measures chordal tooth thickness at a specified chordal depth,not arc thickness directly.

Construction:parts and purpose

Horizontal fixed/sliding jaws measure tooth chord.

A vertical depth slide locates jaws below the tooth tip.

Separate scales/locks establish depth and thickness.

Clean measuring faces make the defined contacts.

Working:sequence and reason

Confirm standard unshifted spur geometry and calculate chordal depth.

Set/verify the depth slide from the tooth tip.

Bring horizontal jaws gently into the tooth flanks at that depth.

Read corrected chordal thickness and compare multiple teeth as required.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Worn tips,wrong depth,burrs and profile shift affect the interpretation;use the applicable tooth-thickness specification.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Gear tooth Vernier આપેલી chordal depth પર chordal tooth thickness માપે;સીધી arc thickness નહિ.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Horizontal fixed/sliding jaws tooth chord માપે.

Vertical depth slide jawsને tooth tipથી નીચે ગોઠવે.

અલગ scales/locks depth અને thickness આપે.

Clean measuring faces defined contacts આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Standard unshifted spur geometry તપાસી chordal depth ગણો.

Tooth tipથી depth slide set/verify કરો.

તે depth પર horizontal jawsને flanks સાથે હળવા contactમાં લો.

Corrected chordal thickness વાંચી જરૂર મુજબ ઘણા teeth તપાસો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Worn tips,wrong depth,burrs,profile shift અર્થઘટન બદલે;લાગુ tooth-thickness specification લો.

body.en:
Given

Unshifted standard spur gear:m2mm,z20,r=mz/2=20mm.

Stepwise solution

  1. Chordal thickness tc=mz sin(pi/(2z))=40sin(4.5°)=3.13836mm
  2. Chordal depth hc=m+r[1−cos(pi/(2z))]=2+20[1−cos(4.5°)]=2.06165mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

Ideal pitch-circle arc thickness=pi m/2=3.14159mm;it is close,but not equal,to the chord.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Unshifted standard spur gear:m2mm,z20,r=mz/2=20mm.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Chordal thickness tc=mz sin(pi/(2z))=40sin(4.5°)=3.13836mm
  2. Chordal depth hc=m+r[1−cos(pi/(2z))]=2+20[1−cos(4.5°)]=2.06165mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Ideal pitch-circle arc thickness=pi m/2=3.14159mm;chord નજીક છે પણ સરખો નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Parallel contacts span several involute teeth;the measured common-normal span reduces dependence on tooth-tip depth setting.

Construction:parts and purpose

A suitable span/tooth micrometer provides parallel contacts.

The selected tooth countk locates both contacts on usable involute flanks.

A force-control/setting standard supports stable readings.

Gear datum and clean flanks support repeatable placement.

Working:sequence and reason

Identify m,z,alpha,profile shift and specified span tooth count.

Calculate the nominal span for the applicable geometry.

Seat the parallel contacts acrossk teeth without touching root/tip regions.

Repeat at several positions;compare with the specified span tolerance.

Remember / avoid this mistake

For an unshifted ideal spur gear:Wk=mcos alpha[pi(k−.5)+z(tan alpha−alpha)];alpha must be in radians inside the involute term.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Parallel contacts ઘણા involute teeth span કરે;common-normal spanમાં tooth-tip depth setting પર આધાર ઓછો થાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

યોગ્ય span/tooth micrometer parallel contacts આપે.

પસંદ tooth count kથી બન્ને contacts usable involute flanks પર આવે.

Force-control/setting standard સ્થિર readings આપે.

Gear datum અને clean flanks repeatable placement આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

m,z,alpha,profile shift,specified span tooth count ઓળખો.

લાગુ geometryનું nominal span ગણો.

Root/tip regionsને અડ્યા વગર k teeth પર parallel contacts બેસાડો.

અનેક positions પર repeat કરી specified span tolerance સાથે સરખાવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Unshifted ideal spur gear માટે:Wk=mcos alpha[pi(k−.5)+z(tan alpha−alpha)];involute termમાં alpha radiansમાં લો.

body.en:
Given

m2mm,z20,alpha20°,k3;assume suitable involute contacts and unshifted teeth.

Stepwise solution

  1. alpha=.34906585rad;inv alpha=tan20°−.34906585=.01490438
  2. W3=2cos20°[pi(3−.5)+20(.01490438)]=15.32088mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

Using20 instead of.34906585 in the subtraction gives a meaningless span.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

m2mm,z20,alpha20°,k3;યોગ્ય involute contacts અને unshifted teeth માનો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. alpha=.34906585rad;inv alpha=tan20°−.34906585=.01490438
  2. W3=2cos20°[pi(3−.5)+20(.01490438)]=15.32088mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

બાદબાકીમાં.34906585ની જગ્યાએ20 મૂકવાથી ખોટો span મળે.

h.en: 5.1.8 Thread geometry:Pitch is not always Lead

body.en:
Definition

Major diameter bounds the crests;minor diameter bounds roots;pitch/effective diameter is the theoretical cylinder where thread ridge and groove widths are equal for the basic profile.

Pitchp is the axial distance between corresponding adjacent thread forms.Lead is axial advance per revolution;lead=number of starts×pitch.

Included flank angle,helix angle and handedness also describe a thread;the usual ISO metric basic included angle is60°.

Example / application

A two-start thread with pitch2mm has lead4mm;one revolution advances4mm.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Pitch diameter is not simply the arithmetic mean of measured major and minor diameters.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Major diameter crestsની boundary,minor diameter rootsની boundary છે;pitch/effective diameter basic profileમાં ridge/groove widths સરખાં થાય તે theoretical cylinderનો diameter છે.

Pitch p adjacent thread formsના સમાન points વચ્ચેનું axial અંતર છે.Lead એક revolutionનો axial advance છે;lead=startsની સંખ્યા×pitch.

Included flank angle,helix angle,handedness પણ thread વર્ણવે;સામાન્ય ISO metric basic included angle60° છે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Two-start threadમાં pitch2mm હોય તો lead4mm;એક revolutionમાં4mm આગળ જાય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Pitch diameter measured major/minor diametersની ફક્ત arithmetic mean નથી.

body.en:
Understand the reason

A pitch-gauge leaf helps identify nominal pitch/profile;correct contact and absence of visible mismatch are screening,not a full pitch-error certificate.

A toolmaker microscope/profile projector with suitable alignment can inspect flank form,pitch and angle;lead measurement needs a defined axial-versus-rotation method.

An outside micrometer checks suitable major-diameter contacts;effective diameter needs a thread micrometer,wire method or other qualified method.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Separate actual/simple pitch-diameter evaluation from functional thread acceptance,which also responds to pitch/angle errors.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Pitch-gauge leaf nominal pitch/profile ઓળખવામાં મદદ કરે;યોગ્ય contact અને mismatch ન દેખાવું screening છે,full pitch-error certificate નહિ.

યોગ્ય alignmentવાળો toolmaker microscope/profile projector flank form,pitch,angle તપાસે;lead માટે defined axial-versus-rotation method જોઈએ.

Outside micrometer યોગ્ય major-diameter contacts માપે;effective diameter માટે thread micrometer,wire method કે બીજી qualified method જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Actual/simple pitch-diameter evaluation અને functional thread acceptance જુદાં છે;functional checkમાં pitch/angle errorsની અસર પણ હોય.

body.en:
Definition

Known wires contact opposite flanks of an external thread;a measurement over the wires is converted to effective diameter using defined geometry.

Construction:parts and purpose

Calibrated equal-diameter wires provide known flank contacts.

A suitable micrometer measures the overall dimensionM.

In the two-wire arrangement one wire is used on each opposing side.

In the three-wire arrangement two wires on one side and one opposite improve seating/stability.

A handling fixture,controlled force and clean flanks limit positioning effects.

Working:sequence and reason

Identify pitch,flank angle and the applicable external-thread geometry.

Select appropriate calibrated wires,ideally near the best size for the profile.

Place wires in the correct opposing arrangement and establish stable flank contact.

MeasureM with the specified force and convert with corrections required by the method.

Repeat and report assumptions;the third wire improves seating,not a new universal ideal equation.

Remember / avoid this mistake

For ideal symmetric60° external threads ignoring helix/force/elastic corrections:E=M−3w+(sqrt(3)/2)p.Best wirew=p/(2cos30°).Real precision work needs the applicable corrected method.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

જાણીતા wires external threadના opposite flanksને અડે;over-wire measurementને defined geometryથી effective diameterમાં ફેરવીએ.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Calibrated equal-diameter wires જાણીતા flank contacts આપે.

યોગ્ય micrometer overall dimension M માપે.

Two-wire arrangementમાં opposite sides પર એક-એક wire હોય.

Three-wireમાં એક બાજુ બે અને સામે એક wireથી seating/stability સુધરે.

Handling fixture,controlled force,clean flanks positioning effects ઘટાડે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Pitch,flank angle અને applicable external-thread geometry ઓળખો.

યોગ્ય calibrated wires લો,શક્ય હોય તો profileના best size નજીક.

યોગ્ય opposite arrangementમાં wires બેસાડી stable flank contact લો.

Specified forceથી M માપી method મુજબ corrections સાથે ફેરવો.

Repeat કરી assumptions આપો;ત્રીજો wire seating સુધારે,નવું universal ideal equation નહિ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Helix/force/elastic corrections અવગણેલા ideal symmetric60° external thread માટે:E=M−3w+(sqrt(3)/2)p.Best wire w=p/(2cos30°).Real precision માટે applicable corrected method જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given

Ideal60° external thread:p1.5mm,M12mm;use best-size wires and neglect specified higher-order corrections.

Stepwise solution

  1. w=1.5/(2cos30°)=.8660254mm
  2. E=12−3(.8660254)+(.8660254)(1.5)=10.700962mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

M is the over-wire reading,not the thread major diameter;the formula is not directly applicable to arbitrary angles or internal threads.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Ideal60° external thread:p1.5mm,M12mm;best-size wires લો અને આપેલા higher-order corrections અવગણો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. w=1.5/(2cos30°)=.8660254mm
  2. E=12−3(.8660254)+(.8660254)(1.5)=10.700962mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

M over-wire reading છે,thread major diameter નહિ;આ formula arbitrary angles કે internal threads માટે સીધું લાગુ નહિ.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Gear answer:define the parameter→draw pitch/base/contact geometry→construction→working→formula assumptions→errors.
  2. Thread answer:label major/minor/effective diameter,pitch,lead and angle;show opposing wire arrangement and defineM,w,p,E before substitution.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Do not mix gear circular pitch with thread axial pitch,or arc tooth thickness with chordal thickness.

Quick check: Two starts,pitch1.5mm:lead?

Lead3mm;wire calculations still use the specified pitch,not blindly the lead.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Gear answer:parameter define→pitch/base/contact geometry દોરો→Construction→Working→formulaની શરતો→errors.
  2. Thread answerમાં major/minor/effective diameter,pitch,lead,angle બતાવો;opposing wire arrangement દોરી substitution પહેલાં M,w,p,E define કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Gear circular pitch અને thread axial pitch,અથવા arc thickness અને chordal thickness ભેળવો નહિ.

જાતે વિચારો: Two Starts,pitch1.5mm હોય તો Lead?

Lead3mm;wire ગણતરીમાં specified pitch વાપરો,આંધળું lead નહિ.

terms.en: Gear equations assume the stated unshifted spur geometry;wire equation assumes ideal60° external thread with listed corrections omitted.

a.en: To position Vernier jaws at the defined tooth chord.

a.en: Alpha is in radians in tan alpha−alpha.
More stable seating;two wires on one side,one opposite.
a.gu: વધુ stable seating;એક બાજુ બે,સામે એક.
